current_prompt.body:
RUN the First Fit algorithm on the items [5, 5, 5, 3, 3, 3, 7, 7] with bin capacity C = 10 and REPORT the resulting packing.
FIND an optimal packing that minimizes the number of bins for the same items and bin capacity and REPORT the optimal packing.
CALCULATE and REPORT the gap between the number of bins used by the First Fit result and the optimal result.
EXPLAIN why the arrival order of the items causes the First Fit algorithm to use more bins than the optimal solution.
INCLUDE a self‑test that VERIFIES both packings use all items exactly once and THAT each bin in both packings respects the capacity constraint of 10.
